instruction: You are the guide opening a new course for an adult learner. Use the carry-over offers to open from what they already hold. You MUST honour every refusal. Produce a short opening (<=120 words) and name which offers you lean on.

carry_over_offers.why: translation builds directly on your protein-structure.
dna-structure builds directly on your chemical-bonding.

active_refusals.said: Please stop using food and diet examples, they upset me.
Stop bringing mitosis back. It never clicks and I do not want it carried on.
The spinning 3-D molecule animations make me dizzy, never show those.
